descriptorText:
Level 3  
Pronunciation and Delivery  
 Pronunciation of most words can be understood.  
 Some stress and intonation patterns help convey meaning.  
 Fluency is evident in res ponse to prompting.  
Communication strategies  
 Some expressions and strategies are used to respond purposefully to others.  
Vocabulary and language patterns  
 A range of simple vocabulary is used appropriately.  
 Simple language patterns are used accur ately and appropriately.  Errors do not usually impede 
communication.  
Ideas and organization  
 Some ideas and information are relevant and expressed clearly.  
 Detail is added to some responses.  
 Conversational exchanges are sustained when prompted.
